content: We use contrastive test sets for evaluation of discourse phenomena for English-Russian by BIBREF11. These test sets allow for testing different kinds of phenomena which, as we show, can be captured from monolingual data with varying success. In this section, we provide test sets statistics and briefly describe the tested phenomena. For more details, the reader is referred to BIBREF11.
